items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: Well, I read it in the book that Louis put out. And he said it happened on the job when they were working down there, around Saratoga Street or somewhere.

ctx.x: I've heard he's very strict. I know one of the last times I saw Louis Armstrong in Chicago. And I don't know how the question of your father came up. If he mentioned him first, he mentioned, I think, the first time he played on the boat. Your father was playing in the band. And Louis was always, he says, short now, you know how small he is. And he must have been real small when he was a kid, 18 or so. And your father was very, oh, I don't know, they say he was very strict and all anyway. And he saw this little…
Well, I read it in the book that Louis put out. And he said it happened on the job when they were working down there, around Saratoga Street or somewhere.
